newsitem.title: FRANCE: Seita sees price uncertainty in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Seita sees price uncertainty in 1997.

text.p: French tobacco company Seita, which just reported a 1996 net attributable of 786 million francs, up 15 percent over 1995, said on Thursday there was great uncertainty over cigarette prices in 1997.

"Market conditions were generally stable at the start of 1996 but deteriorated at the end of the year due to fresh pressures on prices. For 1997 there is great uncertainty over the question of cigarette prices," Seita said in a statement.

"Seita is doing all it can to correct its position in the market for blond tobacco in France, to pursue international development, particularly in Europe, and to defend its interests and those of its shareholders," the company said.
